caps.short_horizon: Because you need this money back within a year, we have kept your profile Conservative. Share prices can fall sharply in the short term, and there may not be time to recover.

description.conservative: Protecting your money comes first. You prefer slow, steady gains over risky bets, so InvestIQ will lean towards stable, lower-volatility companies.
description.moderate: You want growth without losing sleep. InvestIQ will balance steady dividend payers with some higher-growth companies.
description.aggressive: You are comfortable with big ups and downs in exchange for higher long-term growth. InvestIQ will include more high-growth, higher-volatility companies.

prediction.title: AI forecast
prediction.subtitle: From an LSTM price model, with a Random Forest buy/sell/hold signal as a second opinion. Both were trained on liquid KSE-100 stocks and tested on months they never saw.

forecast.up: The model forecasts a {{pct}} rise for the next trading day.
forecast.down: The model forecasts a {{pct}} fall for the next trading day.
forecast.flat: The model forecasts almost no change for the next trading day.

prediction.confidenceHelp: How often forecasts this certain got the direction (up or down) right on past data the model did not train on. It is not a guarantee.
prediction.lowConfidenceIntro: Treat this as a weak signal, not advice:

reason.below_threshold: The chance the direction is right is below {{threshold}}%.
reason.models_disagree: The price forecast and the buy/sell/hold signal point different ways.
reason.no_edge_over_baseline: On past data, this model was not more accurate for {{ticker}} than assuming tomorrow's close equals today's.
reason.sentiment_unavailable: News could not be updated for more than a day, so this forecast uses prices only.

prediction.signalHelp: From a Random Forest classifier. Buy means it expects a rise of more than 1% tomorrow, sell a fall of more than 1%, hold anything in between.
prediction.notCoveredTitle: No forecast for this stock yet
prediction.notCovered: There is no forecast for {{ticker}} yet. Forecasts cover the {{stocks}} liquid KSE-100 stocks the model was trained and tested on.
prediction.insufficientData: Insufficient data for a reliable prediction. This stock doesn't have enough trading history yet.
prediction.notReady: No forecast yet. Forecasts are generated after each trading day's close.
prediction.evaluationTitle: How accurate has this model been for {{ticker}}?
prediction.evaluationDirection: From {{start}} to {{end}}, days the model never saw in training, it called the next day's direction right on {{direction}} of days. Always guessing "{{baselineDirection}}" would have been right on {{baseline}}.
prediction.evaluationErrorBeats: Its forecasts were typically off by {{error}} of the price, slightly better than assuming tomorrow's close equals today's.
prediction.evaluationErrorNoEdge: Its forecasts were typically off by {{error}} of the price, no better than assuming tomorrow's close equals today's.
prediction.evaluationSignal: The buy/sell/hold signal was right on {{accuracy}} of days, versus {{baseline}} for always giving the most common answer.
prediction.evaluationNote: Next-day stock moves are very hard to predict from past prices. These numbers are shown so you can judge the forecast yourself.

inputs.none: This forecast uses prices and technical indicators only. News sentiment is shown below for context.

sentiment.title: News sentiment
sentiment.subtitle: The tone of recent headlines about {{ticker}} in Profit and Mettis Global, scored by FinBERT, a language model trained on financial text.
sentiment.basis: Headlines counted: {{count}}, from the {{days}} trading days up to the close of {{date}}. Newer headlines count more; a headline's weight halves every {{halfLife}} trading days.
sentiment.noNews: No headlines about {{ticker}} from Profit or Mettis Global in the {{days}} trading days up to the close of {{date}}.
sentiment.note: Sentiment describes the tone of recent news, not where the price will go.
sentiment.probabilityNote: The percentage is how sure FinBERT is of each headline's label.
sentiment.scoredByVader: Scored by VADER because FinBERT was unsure
sentiment.afterCloseNote: These count from the next trading day.
sentiment.stale: News could not be updated for more than a day (last update {{date}}). The sentiment shown may be out of date.
sentiment.staleNever: News has not been collected yet, so there is no sentiment to show.
sentiment.notCoveredTitle: No news sentiment for this stock
sentiment.notCovered: News is collected for the {{stocks}} stocks that have forecasts. {{ticker}} is not one of them yet.
sentiment.loadError: We couldn't load the news sentiment.

holding.exitNote: This is a one-day forecast. Buying and selling costs about {{pct}} in total, so very short holds rarely pay.
holding.cgtNone: No capital gains tax: no gain at this price

roll.title: Should anything be switched?
roll.intro: Each holding is compared with the other forecast stocks. A switch is suggested only when a holding has fallen well behind and the expected gain is larger than the cost of switching.
roll.benchmark: Benchmark: the average of the {{count}} forecast stocks since {{date}}, {{pct}}. The KSE-100 index is not available from our price source.

status.too_early: Too early to judge: {{days}} of {{required}} trading days so far.
status.not_triggered: Keep: {{relative}} against the benchmark, inside the {{threshold}} allowed for this stock.
status.no_replacement: It has fallen behind, but no other stock is forecast to do better.
status.costs_exceed_benefit: Switching to {{to}} would cost {{cost}} and is expected to gain only {{benefit}}. Not worth it.
status.suggested: Consider switching to {{to}}: expected gain {{benefit}}, cost of switching {{cost}}.

metrics.caption: Results for each line on the chart
metrics.totalReturnHelp: After every charge and tax. The benchmark has no costs.
metrics.annualisedHelp: The same growth spread evenly over each year.
metrics.sharpeHelp: Return above what 3-month T-bills paid, for each unit of ups and downs. The target is above 1.
metrics.drawdownHelp: The biggest drop from a high point.
metrics.winRateHelp: Months in which the value rose.

gap.available: Rules at the start date use only the prices known on that day, with no forecast or news. Your portfolio's total return minus theirs: {{pp}} percentage points. That difference is roughly what hindsight changed.
gap.tooFew: Rules at the start date could not be applied: too few companies had a full year of prices before {{date}}.
gap.capitalTooLow: Rules at the start date could not be applied: the amount was too small for the rules at that day's prices.

backtest.benchmarkNote: The benchmark is the 18 companies InvestIQ forecasts, in equal parts, bought and held with dividends and no costs. It is not the KSE-100. These companies were chosen in 2026, so the benchmark also benefits from hindsight.

chart.title: Value over time
chart.summary: After {{years}} years, before selling: your portfolio {{portfolio}}, benchmark {{benchmark}}.

method.title: How this was calculated
method.buyHold: Bought at the close on the start date and held to the end, with no changes. Whole shares only; cash left over earned nothing.
method.rates: Charges and taxes use today's PSX rates ({{version}}) for every date; past rates were different.
method.dividends: Dividends come from Yahoo Finance and are added on the ex-date after tax. Amounts not checked against PSX announcements.
method.prices: Prices are adjusted for share splits, up to {{date}}. On {{days}} company-days there was no trade and the last close was used.
method.riskFree: The Sharpe ratio subtracts the SBP 3-month T-bill cut-off yield: {{start}} at the start, from {{low}} to {{high}} during the period. It is a simple yield on a 365-day year, checked against SBP's own auction prices.
method.annualise: Ratios are annualised with the number of trading days per year in the data.
method.winRate: Months up compares each month's last value with the previous month's; a month with no change does not count.
